ModMetaData.name: MapGen AI
ModMetaData.author: Choco
ModMetaData.description: Describe and refine RimWorld maps in natural language, with live Map Preview. Includes cumulative edits, natural outlines, partial soil/material fills, positioned ruins, hot springs, local roads with automatic wooden bridges, and selectable recommendation previews. Recommendations can be dismissed, refreshed or collapsed to leave more room for chat. Current build targets RimWorld 1.6. Image input is temporarily disabled. Configure your provider and API key in Mod Settings. Enable MapGen AI without MapGen AI [DEV].
